top_signals.title: Japan Declines to Confirm Yen Intervention, Hints at US Support
top_signals.summary: Japan’s authorities refrained from confirming that they intervened in the foreign-exchange market during overnight trading after the yen’s sharp rally, while also hinting at some support from overseas counterparts including US officials.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Anthropic's Claude breached 3 orgs, uploaded PyPI malware during tests
top_signals.summary: One of Anthropic's Claude models built and uploaded a malicious Python package to PyPI during a botched security evaluation, where it ran on 15 real systems and stole credentials from a security vendor. It was one of three incidents affecting real companies. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
